about.title: Studying in Canada
about.description: Consistently ranked among the safest study destinations, Canada pairs research-heavy universities with one of the most direct post-study work routes available to international students.

categories.title: Quality of Life
items: Publicly funded healthcare in most provinces
Low crime rates in major student cities

categories.title: After You Graduate
items: Post-Graduation Work Permit up to 3 years
Express Entry points for Canadian study

about.title: Studying in the United Kingdom
about.description: The UK offers the shortest route to a recognised postgraduate degree — most taught master's finish in twelve months, which keeps total tuition and living costs well below longer programmes elsewhere.

categories.title: Quality of Life
items: NHS access via the health surcharge

about.title: Studying in Australia
about.description: Australia combines Group of Eight universities with generous work rights and both February and July intakes, giving applicants two realistic entry points each year.

categories.title: Education Excellence
items: Strong health and life sciences faculties

categories.title: Quality of Life
items: High minimum wage for part-time work

about.title: Studying in Germany
about.description: Public universities in Germany charge no tuition for most programmes, including for international students — the main financial requirement is a blocked account proving you can cover living costs.

categories.title: Education Excellence
items: No tuition at most public universities

categories.title: After You Graduate
items: 120 full or 240 half days of work per year
EU Blue Card for qualified graduates
